title: Counter loop state redirection
statement: Given a state set $S$, a distinguished state $a\in S$, an optional designated exit state, and a state $s\in S$, redirect $s$ to the decrement phase in its run mode if $s=a$; otherwise redirect it to the escape state if it is the designated exit, and to the body state carrying $s$ in all other cases.
hypotheses_covered: A state set $S$ with decidable equality
